rule_invariant.name: One Active Version Per Logical Rule
rule_invariant.description: For any given (program_id, field, category), at most one rule can be in ACTIVE status at any time. When a new version is activated, the previous ACTIVE rule is automatically SUPERSEDED.

failure_invariant.name: Failed Update Never Removes Previous Active Rule
failure_invariant.description: If a government source sync fails (LLM error, compilation error, validation error), the existing ACTIVE rules remain untouched. ACTIVE/SUPERSEDED/RETIRED rules cannot be downgraded to DRAFT.

historical_invariant.name: Assessment Uses Rule Version Captured at Assessment Time
historical_invariant.description: Each AssessmentRuleResult stores the specific rule_version that was active when the assessment was created. Historical assessments are never updated when new rule versions become active.

applicant_invariant.name: Assessment Uses Immutable Applicant Snapshot
applicant_invariant.description: Each assessment stores a frozen copy of the applicant profile (applicant_snapshot) at assessment time. Changing the applicant profile after assessment does not affect historical assessment results.

evidence_invariant.name: Every Active Rule Has Traceable Government Evidence
evidence_invariant.description: Every ACTIVE rule stores provenance: source_id, document_id, document_version, chunk_id, and evidence_text. This chain traces back to the original government document.

eligibility_invariant.name: Eligibility Engine Does Not Use LLM Reasoning
eligibility_invariant.description: The eligibility engine (Phase 3C) is 100% deterministic. It evaluates rule expressions using comparison operators only. No LLM calls are made during assessment.

pipeline_run_invariant.name: PipelineRun Status Is Strictly Forward-Only
pipeline_run_invariant.description: PipelineRun transitions: RUNNING to COMPLETED|FAILED|PARTIAL only. Terminal states cannot transition to any other state.

ruleset_hash_invariant.name: Assessment Records Deterministic Ruleset Fingerprint
ruleset_hash_invariant.description: Each assessment stores a SHA-256 hash of all ACTIVE rule versions used. This provides a compact audit trail: Assessment A used SKILLED_189_RULESET_<hash>.
